title: What If the Space Station Came Down?

scenes.text: What if the International Space Station came down? NASA already has a plan.
It weighs more than 450 tons and circles about 260 miles above Earth.
NASA plans to bring it down on purpose, around 2031.
First it is lowered to about 205 miles, then its lowest point is pulled to about 90 miles before the final burn.
A new SpaceX vehicle, in a contract worth up to 843 million dollars, will push it down.
The pieces are aimed at Point Nemo, about 1,670 miles from the nearest land. It is called the spacecraft cemetery.

description:
What if the International Space Station came down?
